messages:
Mari: Quick check — I'm prototyping an operator-proxy split for Dedicated GPU pool admission. Proxy does fast admits + local throttling; operator is source-of-truth. Thoughts?

Alex: I like the separation. Proxy reduces RPC roundtrips for hot paths. Question: who enforces monthly credits / reserved quotas — proxy cache or operator?

Sam: keep operator authoritative. Proxy enforces short-lived tokens/quotas + circuit-breaker only. Long-lived reservations stay with operator.

Nora: Proxy with transient tokens will cut cold-starts. Operator issues the commitments but proxy owns instant admission path.

Lee: failure mode: if operator restarts proxy cache can drift and accept more than global ledger. Need revocation semantics.

Mari: proposal: signed short TTL leases (1-3s). Proxy verifies signature offline. Operator revokes by rotating epoch id; proxy rejects stale epoch.

Alex: signed leases are neat. Implementation perf risk: operator must sign many leases -> hot path. Can we batch-sign or issue ranges?

Sam: batch issuance + per-tenant range tokens. Also support a small local grace quota so proxy continues on brief operator outages.

Nora: add observability header for rejections: X-Proxy-Reject: NO_CAP|PREEMPT|OP_UNREACHABLE. SDKs can map these to retry policy.

Lee: eviction flow: if operator revokes, proxy returns a retryable code and signals graceful drain to the client. No abrupt kill.

Mari: config sketch:
```
proxy:
  local_quota_per_pool: 40
  lease_ttl_ms: 2500
  grace_allowance: 5
operator:
  lease_batch_size: 256
  epoch_rotate_ms: 5000
  signed_leases: true
```

Sam: token granularity: per-request vs per-slot. For Dedicated we must support slot-level leases for persistent sessions and per-request tokens for short RPCs.

Alex: agree. Proxy API should have two endpoints: /admit-request and /acquire-slot. Different token semantics.

Nora: UX: surface retryable vs non-retryable codes in SDK. Also expose rejection header and recommended backoff. Console docs + examples please.

deploy-bot: canary deploy: proxy v0.3 -> cohort A. lease_issue_latency p50=10ms p95=45ms. operator signing QPS +12%.

Mari: action items: (1) Sam+Alex prototype signed lease payload + compact encoding, (2) Nora add X-Proxy-Reject and map to SDK error classes, (3) Lee run chaos test on operator leader failover. I'll draft RFC after prototyping.

Nora: small note: include epoch id and signed mac in payload to detect stale leader. Keep payload minimal (<128 bytes).

Alex: I'll add example SDK retry snippet and exponential backoff recommendations.

Mari: thanks — moving this to RFC draft tomorrow unless objections. :rocket:
